title: Remove the size return value when copying chunked files
body:
Draft: As a courtesy to an external contributor, this should wait after #1190 .

It is used only in tests, where we can easily get the value another way; so, simplify the code.

This also avoids a `stat(/proc/self/fd/…)` before creating a hard link.

Should not change behavior.
